doc: Registered grounds for research/event_surprise.py: pages that publish a macro release's consensus and/or actual. Every row is fetched if it names an http(s) url and a declared field map (LAWS 5e). Licence/access text is a redistribution label, never a brake. No credential is ever sent; a key/paid row has only its open surface read.

sources.name: Forex Factory weekly calendar feed (this week)
sources.licence: public JSON feed of the Forex Factory calendar; numbers are read and tested, the feed itself is not redistributed
sources.actual_note: QG-OT-003 (2026-10-06): the feed never carries the released actual (1,380 captured vintage rows, 0 with an actual); the actual half is ALFRED's first print (macro/release_vintages.py)
